question: Can at most two distinct useful native EMC empirical questions be computed from actual accessible processed data with complete source/condition/assay/control accountability, without repeating failed or already published phenotypes?
scope: Internal immutable evidence and file/schema audit only; zero network requests/new raw; no new gene, matrix, endpoint or classifier outcomes.
selection: Exploratory after multiple R1-R9 candidate decisions; prior quantitative summaries already known, no claim of blinded candidate discovery. Do not select favorable old values as a new phenotype.
usefulness: A result must change an EMC researcher measurement or next experiment. A disease-specific RNA contrast can suffice without a universal protein veto, but new panel, significance or inventory alone is insufficient.
required_before_proposal: Exact unanswered biological question and consequential decision
Primary prior art and precise difference from all verified shelved/published hypotheses
Actual accessible processed file/hash/fields and endpoint units
Authenticated all-native observations plus fixed defensible comparison/control and overlap/replicate rules
Known outcome exposure and mixture/batch/handling/lineage alternatives
A discriminating result that defeats value/interpretation
Every relevant public EMC pending condition and promotion blocker preserved
exclusions: No DLK1/TMEM266/R8 failed panel rescue, unrelated new target scan, old static IR/APA/clock questions, manufactured negative, source-access repair or methodological demonstration as discovery. Exact denied FAP tissue/glycan/HLA/structural-genomics/fusion-forming/topology scopes excluded.
possible_outcome: At most two concrete computable proposals, or honest no currently viable option. Neither result meets discovery goal or establishes global exhaustion.
ownership: Only empirical_opportunity_selection; all previous freezes immutable; Codex both identities; root alone shared integration/push.
